verdict.rationale: The work product is inherently portable. Code lives in your own GitHub repos via GitHub-backed delivery with no migration. Skills are plain markdown files (design.md, review.md). Tasks sync both ways with Linear/Jira, and model access is explicitly 'no lock-in'. However, there is no documented export of LightSprint-held data such as plans, task history, audit logs, screenshots or recordings, and probes found no public OpenAPI spec for programmatic extraction. missing for 10: an explicit full-account data export feature, documented open export formats for tasks/plans/audit logs/media, a public API for bulk extraction, independent confirmation of clean exit.
